description_en: Deletes the episode list for carousel playback in a production studio
kebab_example: aliyun live delete-caster-program --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --caster-id a2b8e671-2fe5-4642-a2ec-bf93880e0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteCasterProgram

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the production studio.

- If you create a production studio by calling the [CreateCaster](~~2848009~~) operation, use the CasterId value returned in the response.

- If you create a production studio in the ApsaraVideo Live console, go to the **Production Studio** > **Cloud Production Studio** page to view the ID.

> The name of a production studio in the list on the Cloud Production Studio page is its ID.
parameters.description_zh:
导播台ID。

- 如果您通过[CreateCaster接口](~~2848009~~)创建导播台，请查看CreateCaster接口调用返回的参数CasterId值。

- 如果您通过直播控制台创建导播台，请通过**直播控制台** > **导播台** > **云导播台**页面查看。

> 直播控制台云导播台页面导播台列表中的导播台名称即导播台ID。
